heroHeadline: Abu Dhabi Talks End With 314-POW Swap Agreed in Principle, No Ceasefire Breakthrough
heroSubtitle: The Nov 10-11 US-mediated round ended with no deal on ceasefire terms, territory or security guarantees; Witkoff and Kushner were due to meet Putin in Moscow next. Overnight Nov 11, Russia reported 146 drones downed over Leningrad region.
